# AbstractUIC

> UI packages for AbstractFramework clients: React components (ESM + CSS exports), dependency-free Custom Elements for GPU and host memory metrics, a Node.js Gateway session proxy, and `ui-kit` console islands (a script build of the kit components for non-React pages).

AbstractUIC is a **multi-package repository**: each top-level folder is an independently-consumable npm package.

Ecosystem context (external):
- AbstractFramework: https://github.com/lpalbou/AbstractFramework
- AbstractCore: https://github.com/lpalbou/abstractcore
- AbstractRuntime: https://github.com/lpalbou/abstractruntime

Important integration notes:
- Components are **host-driven**: hosts provide data + callbacks; packages don’t import host code.
- Only `@abstractframework/monitor-gpu` and `@abstractframework/monitor-memory` perform network requests by default (each polls a metrics endpoint; optional Bearer auth).
- Always import the package CSS from your app entrypoint (especially in Next.js). Start with `docs/getting-started.md` → `docs/api.md`.

Quick commands:

```bash
npm install
npm run build
npm test
python scripts/generate-llms-full.py
```

CSS entrypoints (import from your app entrypoint):

```ts
import "@abstractframework/ui-kit/theme.css";
import "@abstractframework/panel-chat/panel_chat.css";
import "@abstractframework/monitor-flow/agent_cycles.css";
import "@abstractframework/monitor-active-memory/styles.css";
import "reactflow/dist/style.css"; // only when using monitor-active-memory
```

Peer dependencies:
- React packages: `react@^18`, `react-dom@^18`
- `@abstractframework/monitor-active-memory`: `reactflow@^11`

If you cannot follow links, use `llms-full.txt` (generated; inlines the contents of the key docs and source-of-truth files listed below).

## Start here

- [README](README.md): overview, package map, ecosystem context
- [Getting started](docs/getting-started.md): install/integrate, required CSS, quick examples, Next.js notes
- [Adoption guide](docs/adoption-guide.md): which shared component for which job + the cross-app contracts (connection surface, server truth, labeled fallbacks)
- [Theming](docs/theming.md): design-token vocabulary, 21-theme system, adoption/migration rules for host apps
- [Modal, account rows, grouped navigation](docs/modal.md): `AfModal` (960 px × 90vh dialog over a blurred backdrop, full-screen sheet under 768 px, focus trap, Escape/backdrop close), its plain-HTML markup and `AfConsoleIslands.bindModal` / `bindAfModal`, the `af-row--admin|user|entity` tints with `af-kind-chip`, `af-nav-group` captions and `af-nav-footer`, and the `--af-helper-size` floor (13 px desktop, 14 px touch)
- [On/off settings](docs/state-toggles.md): `AfSwitch` (a `role="switch"` labelled by the feature, highlighted when on; unavailable = `aria-disabled` + reason), the `af-switch` CSS block the consoles copy, the terminal `[x]`/`[ ]`/`[-]` marker, `findVerbToggleLabels` (the guard against "Email off"/"Email on" labels), `checkLabelScale` (labels at body size), unavailable-reason strings, the sign-in card classes, `af-form`/`af-card`/`af-tabs` + `AfTabs`, and `randomId()` / `insecureContextReason()` for plain-http pages
- [Responsive layout](docs/responsive.md): breakpoints (480/768/1024/1440 px, short and touch axes), 44 px touch targets and 16 px form text on touch screens, bottom-sheet dialogs and drawers above the keyboard, container queries and their thresholds, `installViewportVars()` / `viewportVarsFrom()`, the font-size order, and how a host app adopts them
- [API reference](docs/api.md): export map per package (what to import)
- [Architecture](docs/architecture.md): package boundaries + diagrams (packages and their consumers, ecosystem data flow, gateway connection flow, live replies, About/identity flow, automations flow, console islands build)
- [FAQ](docs/faq.md): bundling/CSS/SSR and per-package notes
- [Troubleshooting](docs/troubleshooting.md): symptoms, checks and fixes (unstyled components, SSR errors, widget polling, app-server 400/401/403, live replies, images shown as links, stale islands bundle, plain-http copy/voice/ids)
- [Automations](docs/automations.md): configurable growing-context budgets and result email; show and manage AbstractGateway automations — `AutomationPanel` (icon controls, an Edit form a host can open through `editOpen`, runs as chat pairs, typed wait answers), `AfScheduleDialog` (fixed UTC intervals, **When an email arrives** with typed filters, **Email result**, recipients, workflow and tool selection), `createAutomationsClient()` and its error model, retry-safe ids, panel-chat `ScheduleThisAction` / `FromAutomationBadge`, the canonical fixtures and the export list
- [Console islands](docs/console-islands.md): `window.AfConsoleIslands` (mountTopBar / mountAppearance / mountAbout / appIdentity / applyAppearance) for pages that are not React apps; repository build, not in the npm package
- [Docs index](docs/README.md): full docs navigation

## Packages

- [@abstractframework/ui-kit](ui-kit/README.md): theme tokens (21 themes) and the responsive layer (breakpoints, touch sizes, sheets, viewport helpers), inputs (AfSelect, ProviderModelPicker), Gateway connect modal + useGatewayConnection hook, top bar / drawer / rail drawer (AfRailDrawer) / appearance dialog, file viewer (AfFileViewer, AfCodeBlock), settings rows (AfSettingsGroup, AfSettingRow, AfOverrideRow) + AfVoiceSection, relative time, About dialog + AbstractFramework identity helpers, console islands, tool policy editor, phase capability matrix, critical action dialog, steer composer, disclosure list, chips, icons, voice hook (streaming TTS + push-to-talk), automations panel (Active switch) + schedule dialog + client, AfSwitch, AfTabs, AfModal, randomId
- [@abstractframework/panel-chat](panel-chat/README.md): chat thread/message UI + markdown/json renderers, AssistantPanel, WorkflowChat, live replies (`llm.delta`), ScheduleThisAction + FromAutomationBadge, WorkspaceBrowser, presentInteraction
- [@abstractframework/app-server](app-server/README.md): Node server side for apps: serving under the gateway's `/apps/<id>/` (base path, forwarded client address, identity header), the shared launch flags (`--gateway-url`, `--port`, `--host`), the local gateway pointer reader, and the gateway-session proxy (token → HttpOnly cookies, CSRF, URL pinning, forwarded client address + app-proxy marker; no runtime deps)
- [@abstractframework/monitor-flow](monitor-flow/README.md): agent-cycle trace viewer + ledger adapter
- [@abstractframework/monitor-active-memory](monitor-active-memory/README.md): KG + Active Memory explorer (ReactFlow)
- [@abstractframework/monitor-gpu](monitor-gpu/README.md): GPU widget (`<monitor-gpu>`) + backend contract
- [@abstractframework/monitor-memory](monitor-memory/README.md): host RAM + device memory widget (`<monitor-memory>`) + backend contract

## Source of truth (public API)

- [package.json](package.json): workspace scripts + package list
- [ui-kit/package.json](ui-kit/package.json): published metadata (`exports`, peer deps)
- [panel-chat/package.json](panel-chat/package.json): published metadata (`exports`, peer deps)
- [monitor-flow/package.json](monitor-flow/package.json): published metadata (`exports`, peer deps)
- [monitor-active-memory/package.json](monitor-active-memory/package.json): published metadata (`exports`, peer deps)
- [monitor-gpu/package.json](monitor-gpu/package.json): published metadata (`exports`)
- [ui-kit/src/index.ts](ui-kit/src/index.ts): exports for `@abstractframework/ui-kit`
- [ui-kit/src/responsive.ts](ui-kit/src/responsive.ts): `AF_BREAKPOINTS`, `AF_MEDIA`, `useAfMedia`, `installViewportVars`, `viewportVarsFrom`
- [ui-kit/src/identity.ts](ui-kit/src/identity.ts): identity helpers (`appIdentity`, `aboutRows`, `gatewayVersionRows`)
- [ui-kit/src/about.tsx](ui-kit/src/about.tsx): `AfAboutDialog`
- [ui-kit/src/af_rail_drawer.tsx](ui-kit/src/af_rail_drawer.tsx): `AfRailDrawer` (vertical rail drawer) and its pure rules
- [ui-kit/src/af_file_viewer.tsx](ui-kit/src/af_file_viewer.tsx): `AfFileViewer`, `fileViewerKind`; [code_highlight.tsx](ui-kit/src/code_highlight.tsx): `AfCodeBlock`, `highlightCode`
- [ui-kit/src/af_settings_rows.tsx](ui-kit/src/af_settings_rows.tsx): `AfSettingsGroup`, `AfSettingRow`, `AfOverrideRow`; [af_voice_section.tsx](ui-kit/src/af_voice_section.tsx): `AfVoiceSection`; [relative_time.ts](ui-kit/src/relative_time.ts): `formatRelativeTime`, `formatExactTime`
- [panel-chat/src/file_viewer.tsx](panel-chat/src/file_viewer.tsx): `FileViewer`, `useWorkspaceFilePreview`
- [ui-kit/src/gateway_session_signin.tsx](ui-kit/src/gateway_session_signin.tsx): shared Gateway browser-session sign-in card
- [ui-kit/src/use_gateway_connection.ts](ui-kit/src/use_gateway_connection.ts): the connection state machine hook (probe/auto-open/self-close contract)
- [ui-kit/src/gateway_paths.ts](ui-kit/src/gateway_paths.ts): relative same-origin routes (`gatewayApiPath`, `joinBaseUrl`, `gatewayResourcePath`)
- [ui-kit/src/automations/types.ts](ui-kit/src/automations/types.ts): wire shapes of the Gateway automation routes (`AutomationSummary`, `OccurrenceRow`, typed waits, `CreateAutomationRequest`, `ApiError`)
- [ui-kit/src/automations/client.ts](ui-kit/src/automations/client.ts): `createAutomationsClient()`, `AutomationApiError`, error envelope parsing
- [ui-kit/src/automations/panel_core.ts](ui-kit/src/automations/panel_core.ts): pure rules (controls, occurrence tones, labels, create body, wait helpers, retry-safe ids)
- [ui-kit/scripts/fixtures/automations/README.md](ui-kit/scripts/fixtures/automations/README.md): the canonical automation fixtures and their checksum rule
- [ui-kit/islands/console_islands.tsx](ui-kit/islands/console_islands.tsx): console islands entry and `AfConsoleIslands` API
- [ui-kit/scripts/build_islands.mjs](ui-kit/scripts/build_islands.mjs): islands bundle build (`--check` detects a stale bundle)
- [ui-kit/palette_seeds.json](ui-kit/palette_seeds.json): generated 4-token palette per theme (for non-CSS consumers)
- [app-server/src/gateway_session_proxy.js](app-server/src/gateway_session_proxy.js): gateway session proxy (cookie exchange, CSRF, URL pinning)
- [app-server/src/mount.js](app-server/src/mount.js): serving under `/apps/<id>/` (`createMountedHandler`, `requestContext`, `injectShell`, cookies, identity header)
- [app-server/src/flags.js](app-server/src/flags.js): shared launch flags (`parseAppFlags`)
- [app-server/src/gateway_pointer.js](app-server/src/gateway_pointer.js): local gateway pointer reader and the gateway URL precedence
- [app-server/package.json](app-server/package.json): published metadata (`exports`)
- [app-server/src/index.js](app-server/src/index.js): exports for `@abstractframework/app-server`
- [app-server/src/index.d.ts](app-server/src/index.d.ts): TS types for the app-server exports
- [panel-chat/src/index.ts](panel-chat/src/index.ts): exports for `@abstractframework/panel-chat`
- [panel-chat/src/chat_message_card.tsx](panel-chat/src/chat_message_card.tsx): `ChatMessage` / `ChatAttachment` / `ChatStat` contracts
- [panel-chat/src/automation_badges.tsx](panel-chat/src/automation_badges.tsx): `ScheduleThisAction` and `FromAutomationBadge`
- [panel-chat/src/workspace_browser.tsx](panel-chat/src/workspace_browser.tsx): `WorkspaceBrowser`, `openGatewayResource`, `tabOpenPlan`
- [panel-chat/src/present_interaction.tsx](panel-chat/src/present_interaction.tsx): `presentInteraction` (runtime wait → `WorkflowChat` control)
- [panel-chat/src/llm_delta.ts](panel-chat/src/llm_delta.ts): live-reply events (`llm.delta` / `llm.delta_end`), SSE dispatch helper, `streamRepliesRuntime`
- [panel-chat/src/message_content.tsx](panel-chat/src/message_content.tsx): JSON autodetect + Markdown override hook (`renderMarkdown`)
- [panel-chat/src/markdown.tsx](panel-chat/src/markdown.tsx): Markdown renderer rules (minimal, no external deps)
- [monitor-flow/src/index.ts](monitor-flow/src/index.ts): exports for `@abstractframework/monitor-flow`
- [monitor-flow/src/agent_cycles_adapter.ts](monitor-flow/src/agent_cycles_adapter.ts): `build_agent_trace` adapter contract
- [monitor-active-memory/src/index.ts](monitor-active-memory/src/index.ts): exports for `@abstractframework/monitor-active-memory`
- [monitor-active-memory/src/types.ts](monitor-active-memory/src/types.ts): `KgAssertion` / `KgQueryParams` / `KgQueryResult` contracts
- [monitor-gpu/src/index.js](monitor-gpu/src/index.js): exports for `@abstractframework/monitor-gpu`
- [monitor-gpu/src/index.d.ts](monitor-gpu/src/index.d.ts): TS types (`MonitorGpuElement`, controller options)
- [monitor-gpu/src/gpu_metrics_api.js](monitor-gpu/src/gpu_metrics_api.js): endpoint/auth/payload parsing contract
- [monitor-gpu/src/monitor_gpu_widget.js](monitor-gpu/src/monitor_gpu_widget.js): custom element + controller behavior
- [monitor-memory/package.json](monitor-memory/package.json): published metadata (`exports`)
- [monitor-memory/src/index.js](monitor-memory/src/index.js): exports for `@abstractframework/monitor-memory`
